data.one_liner: Integrate Freshchat modern messaging and chat support in mobile applications.
data.what_it_does: Freshchat SDK helps you integrate customer engagement and chat support directly into your mobile apps. It supports both Android and iOS platforms, providing native SDK bindings, bot flow handling, and messaging features.
use_when: You need to provide in-app chat support and customer messaging for sales or support teams.
You are already using Freshchats customer engagement platform.
avoid_when: You are looking for general push notification handling without the Freshchat backend service.
You require a fully open-source custom chat backend.
strengths: Supports Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods on iOS.
Handles bot flows, push notification bridging, and rich messaging features natively.
weaknesses: Tied to the proprietary Freshchat backend and services.
License is unknown according to pubspec metadata.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring native iOS (minimum deployment target 13.0, optional Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods) and Android dependencies, plus setting up push notification bridging headers if needed.

alternatives.name: intercom_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you prefer Intercom's customer service and messaging platform over Freshchat.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you need general push notifications and in-app messaging rather than a dedicated customer support chat platform.
